name: ECA Views data export
description: Integrates ECA with the Views Data Export module: fires an ECA event as each export row is built and provides an action to rewrite a row's column values.
project_description: ECA Views data export bridges the ECA (Event-Condition-Action) rules engine to the Views Data Export module. It exposes a per-row ECA event that is dispatched from views_data_export's hook_views_data_export_row_alter() as each result row is serialized, letting no-code ECA models inspect the row and the underlying Views result and rewrite the outgoing cells. It ships a 'Set column value' ECA action plus DTO-backed tokens for the current row and result, and adds no routes, permissions or settings of its own.
